% Results paragraph of the introduction (numbers of the best LLM, i.e. the most optimal runs
% after Step 3; RQ2 and RQ3 also for this LLM).
Across two LLMs and three PRISM environments, the networks of the best LLM,
Kimi-K3.1-Pro, select an optimal action in 98.9\% of the states
after creation, 100.0\% after dataset repair, and 100.0\% after
model-checking repair, and they reach the optimal probability in 9
of 9 runs, compared to 9 runs without model-checking
feedback. Policies programmed for two transporter jobs also complete three jobs
in 2 of 3 runs, and the pipeline programs a policy that
satisfies a fuel-reserve safety requirement in 3 of 3
runs.
